name: Glitterdust

outcomes.success: The target's invisibility is negated for 2 rounds.
outcomes.failure: The target is dazzled for 1 minute and its invisibility is negated for 1 minute.
outcomes.criticalFailure: The target is blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 10 minutes. Its invisibility is negated for 10 minutes.

entries: Creatures in the area are outlined by glittering dust. Each creature must attempt a Reflex save. If a creature has its invisibility negated by this spell, it is concealed instead of invisible. This applies both if the creature was already invisible and if it benefits from new invisibility effects before the end of the invisibility negation effect from this spell.
